doc: Allocates the next primitive from the current display-list buffer pointed to by D_80083160[0]->cur, initializes it via SetDrawMode(prim,0,0,0,0), links it into the OT with AddPrim(D_80083160[0]->ot, prim), then advances the cursor by 0xC bytes (one primitive slot).

globals.decl: extern S_80044B48 *D_80083160[3]; /* array of 3 pointers to graphics-context structs; here D_80083160[0]->ot (offset 0x8AC, s32[9]) is the OT array and D_80083160[0]->cur (offset 0x8D0, void*) is the primitive buffer cursor. Other TUs in this codebase model D_80083160 differently (as a scalar struct with fields like field_BC/field_154/etc.) — those views need reconciling against this array-of-pointers layout during integration, matching the existing code8.c declaration `extern void *D_80083160[3];`.
